baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "distress touched us and our household," "merchandise of little account," and "give us full measure."
baseline_models.mechanism: Household damage has reduced the visitors' exchange capacity: they offer a commercially usable piece, explicitly mark it as deficient, and nevertheless ask the distributor to complete the food measure. Need, countervalue, and requested quantity are deliberately unequal.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaches and marks its object, making distress an experienced impact rather than a distant condition.
The near group bound by household and kinship expands the deficit from the speakers to their dependent social body.
Loss and diminished condition opposed to benefit supply the negative balance the petition seeks to repair.
A portion of wealth made into tradable goods supplies the offered side of the exchange.
A slight or defective item that passes only because it is little regarded marks the countervalue as openly inadequate.
Completion without deficiency supplies the requested movement from short payment to an undiminished allotment.
Measured food makes the desired completion concrete and distributive rather than merely emotional.

changed_reading.before: The brothers ask to purchase another ration despite poverty.
changed_reading.after: They expose a household deficit and ask the authority to preserve a full subsistence allotment even though their countervalue can no longer support an equivalent exchange.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The move from "give us full measure" to "give charity to us," followed by "God recompenses those who give charity."
baseline_models.mechanism: The petition distinguishes two ledgers. The commercial ledger cannot balance because the goods are deficient; a voluntary gift can bridge it, while divine recompense becomes the giver's return. The requested surplus is therefore not hidden in the price but openly transferred to another economy of repayment.

activation_trace.role: Full settlement establishes the commercial completeness that the offered goods cannot themselves purchase.
Voluntary relinquishment of wealth or right supplies the noncommercial bridge and names both the requested act and its actor.
A deed met by its answering recompense relocates the giver's expected return from the petitioners to God.
One value standing in for and sufficing in place of another makes divine return functionally replace the missing human price.

changed_reading.before: The appeal for charity merely intensifies a request for generosity.
changed_reading.after: The speakers propose a triangular settlement: the distributor completes their deficient exchange, and God's recompense stands as the return that they cannot provide.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: They enter upon him, address him as al-Aziz, state their case, and present what they brought.
baseline_models.mechanism: Physical entry becomes entry into a controlled audience and distribution system. Naming the powerful office, articulating the deficit, and presenting the goods form a negotiated petition in which speech itself must cross the distance between weak applicants and an empowered allocator.

activation_trace.role: Crossing into an interior supplies the spatial threshold at which the petition becomes actionable.
Negotiation about an affair makes their utterance a bargaining act rather than a neutral report.
Power and invulnerability locate completion of the measure in the addressee's superior capacity.
Bringing and making an item present turns the meager merchandise into evidence placed before the authority.

changed_reading.before: They arrive and tell an official that they are poor.
changed_reading.after: Their entry, title, speech, and presentation stage a formal threshold petition whose success depends on moving power from strict distribution into discretionary mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding dispute tests an unequal exchange in bodies: after a theft attribution, the brothers offer one person in another's place, and Joseph rejects taking anyone but the one tied to the found property as wrongful placement. Against that failed substitution, the focus petition asks deficient goods to stand for full food but explicitly leaves the gap to voluntary charity. The inequality is no longer enforced through custody; it can be crossed only by gift.

activation_trace.role: Attributing theft to a person supplies the charge that converts goods, guilt, and bodily custody into one contested account.
Taking as seizure or captivity gives the proposed person-for-person substitution its coercive material force.
Taking in relation to culpability supplies the restriction that custody must follow the implicated party rather than convenience.
Putting a thing in the wrong sensible place marks arbitrary substitution as a disorder of positions.
A tradable portion now replaces the earlier offer of a person as the petitioners' tender.
A freely surrendered financial right supplies the ethically different means of absorbing the remaining mismatch.

structural_cues: The offer "take one of us in his place" is followed by refusal to take anyone except the one linked to the found property.
The focus preserves inequality between tender and requested measure but changes the proposed bridge from seizure to charity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rejected bodily substitution, its injustice rationale, and then an underfunded request for voluntary giving; I infer that the latter is an ethical redesign of unequal exchange. A live alternative is that the custody dispute and grain petition are adjacent but functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: Deficient merchandise is simply the best payment impoverished buyers can offer.
changed_reading.after: The tender arrives after a failed attempt to make one body pay for another, so charity becomes the only noncoercive way to let an unequal exchange succeed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Secrecy, private counsel, claims of knowledgeable witness, and the post-focus naming of their former ignorance create a double audience. The petitioners speak to an official while the concealed brother and informed judge hears them. Their accurate account of distress is therefore also unwitting self-disclosure before someone whose identity they cannot yet read.

activation_trace.role: Keeping something hidden inwardly supplies the concealed knowledge carried by the addressee into the later audience.
The negated emergence of what is hidden establishes a reveal axis that remains unresolved when the focus begins.
Secret mutual speech supplies a second layer of withheld discourse among the petitioners themselves.
Giving a statement from knowledge frames the brothers' speech as testimony with epistemic limits.
Lack of knowledge retrospectively names the blindness under which the focus audience and petition occurred.
An interior or secret dimension makes entering upon him also an approach to a concealed personal reality.
Voiced speech exposes their condition to the hearer even while the hearer's identity remains unexposed to them.

structural_cues: Joseph first keeps his response inside and does not disclose it.
The focus occurs immediately before he asks whether they know what they did while ignorant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asymmetric concealment and testimony language; I infer that the focus plea functions as an inadvertent deposition before the concealed injured brother. The live alternative is that secrecy governs identity alone and does not alter the pragmatic force of their request.

changed_reading.before: A transparent poverty statement is delivered to the official who controls grain.
changed_reading.after: The statement is doubly heard: as a grain petition by the official and as unwitting testimony by brothers standing before the person whose hidden history makes their present distress legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence gives the family injury bodily and dispersive form: Jacob's grief roughens the self and marks his eyes, concealed pain is poured out, and the dispersed household is finally gathered. This widens "distress touched us and our household" beyond famine. The speakers name a shared family wound whose full membership and causes they do not yet comprehend.

activation_trace.role: Grief as inward roughness supplies a noncommercial injury already borne by the petitioners' father.
Releasing what was hidden in the self shows the family damage moving from containment into utterance.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the later repair of the same extended household body.
Near kinship expressed as close contact lets the verb of touching carry damage through family relation.
The household bond anchors the widened referent in the focus rather than making grief an independent theme.
Diminution, illness, and bad condition permit the named harm to include bodily and affective loss alongside scarcity.

structural_cues: Jacob's grief and complaint precede the focus; family gathering and restored sight follow it.
The speakers say both "us" and "our household," leaving the radius of injury wider than their immediate bodies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies famine language, paternal grief, expressed inner pain, and reunion; I infer that "our household" unintentionally includes the very father and brother whose suffering the speakers only partly know. The narrower alternative is that the phrase refers only to dependents affected by food shortage.

changed_reading.before: The speakers report that famine has harmed their immediate dependents.
changed_reading.after: They unknowingly voice the condition of a dispersed kinship body: economic need, paternal grief, missing brothers, and their own culpability have all touched the household they name.

context_deltas.mechanism: The approach to the focus oscillates from cut-off hope to active tracking and anticipated relief; immediately afterward comes gratuitous release and recognition. The meager goods are thus not only low-value payment. They are the slight means by which the brothers keep moving through a nearly closed situation until entry becomes encounter.

activation_trace.role: Hope cut off supplies the low point from which the later journey must restart.
Following traces and news converts hope from sentiment into the directed search that carries them to the focus audience.
Relief and release supply the open possibility that opposes despair and makes another approach rational.
Free release without counterpayment supplies the post-focus realization of the hoped-for opening.
Something gently driven until it proceeds makes the merchandise a carrier of continued motion through blocked circumstances.
Getting through days on little gives the deficient goods a temporal role as means of endurance, not just a market valuation.
Entry marks the moment when search carried by slight means crosses into encounter.

structural_cues: The command not to despair and to track news directly precedes the focus.
Recognition and an unpriced divine favor directly follow the petition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies despair, renewed search, relief, entry, and free favor; I infer that the meager merchandise is the material vehicle of persistent hope. The live alternative is that its smallness has only a commercial function.

changed_reading.before: The poor-quality tender records the brothers' exhausted resources.
changed_reading.after: The tender also embodies persistence: with almost nothing, they keep the household moving until one more entry opens the concealed path to relief.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, the language of free favor, unrelinquished reward, admitted sin, removed blame, covering forgiveness, and mercy expands the account being settled. The requested full measure is delivered inside a larger nonretaliatory settlement: Joseph does not collect moral arrears from the petitioners, and the charity they request becomes release from blame as well as food.

activation_trace.role: Release given without an equivalent return supplies the gratuitous mode of the answer.
A thing not being lost or gone secures the moral return that mirrors the petition's assurance of divine recompense.
Payment answering work supplies an explicit post-focus moral counterpart to measured commercial return.
Admitted sin supplies the outstanding moral liability that the grain transaction alone cannot settle.
Withheld reproach removes collection through blame at the moment Joseph could exact it.
Covering a fault while protecting its bearer from the consequence supplies moral remission rather than denial of the debt.
Tender mercy supplies the affective force that closes the account without retaliation.
The concrete food measure anchors the expanded moral accounting in the focus transaction.
Giving up wealth or right allows charity to include relinquishing a claim against the petitioners.
Demanding and collecting an owed account supplies the path Joseph declines when he removes blame.

structural_cues: The petition invokes divine recompense; the recognition scene repeats that God does not lose the reward of good action.
Admission of fault is answered by no blame, forgiveness, and mercy rather than by an exacted penalty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commercial measurement beside reward, fault, remission, and mercy; I infer a cross-domain account in which Joseph's charity includes waiving moral collection. The live alternative is that charity refers only to extra grain while forgiveness forms a separate response.

changed_reading.before: They ask for full grain and perhaps an additional alms.
changed_reading.after: Their request enters a larger settlement: Joseph supplies food, declines to collect the debt of blame, and lets divine recompense answer both material generosity and moral forbearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus foregrounds valuation while withholding recognition. The brothers correctly label their merchandise as little regarded and address the rare, powerful man as al-Aziz, yet they do not know that the person before them is their lost brother. Knowledge, ignorance, later acknowledged preference, and restored sight turn the market scene into an epistemic misvaluation: they can price the goods but cannot yet appraise the encounter.

activation_trace.role: Something becoming disclosed to a knower initiates the post-petition conversion from unrecognized encounter to knowledge.
Absence of knowledge names the condition under which both their former action and present audience have been conducted.
Preference by selection supplies the later corrected ranking of the brother they once failed to value.
Recovered eyesight extends the recognition sequence from knowing the brother to repaired family perception.
Rarity and difficulty of attainment make the title carry an unrecognized value beyond administrative power.
Their explicit appraisal of the tender as slight provides the visible act of valuation against which failed recognition is read.

structural_cues: They address Joseph by office in the focus and identify him by name immediately afterward.
The sequence moves from ignorance to recognition and later from blindness to sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit low valuation, a title connoting difficult attainment, ignorance, recognition, preference, and sight; I infer a deliberate contrast between pricing an object and perceiving a person. The live alternative is that the two value fields merely coincide.

changed_reading.before: The only misvaluation in the scene concerns poor merchandise.
changed_reading.after: The greater misvaluation is perceptual: while accurately discounting what is in their hands, they fail to recognize the rare and precious kin directly before them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calls to gather the dispersed family bracket the focus request for completion without deficiency. Full measure is the local object of the plea, but the sequence scales completeness from food quantity to household composition: the grain measure can be filled immediately, while the larger lack is filled only when every separated member is brought together.

activation_trace.role: Joining separated persons supplies the pre-focus hope for a completion larger than the grain allotment.
Wholeness without dispersion or lack supplies the post-focus realization of complete family return.
An undiminished completion anchors the family-scale activation in the explicit request for a full measure.
The household group supplies the entity whose deeper deficiency is dispersion rather than food alone.

structural_cues: Jacob hopes that God will bring them all together before the focus.
Joseph commands the brothers to bring their households all together after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated gathering language around a focus request for completeness; I infer that full measure acts as a small material rehearsal of full reunion. The live alternative is a thematic parallel without a causal or symbolic relation.

changed_reading.before: Completion means filling the requested food measure.
changed_reading.after: The filled measure sits inside an unfinished family measure: the deeper completion is the gathering of every member of the household that distress has dispersed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary mapping of the speech root to a smallness root rather than the ordinary saying sense. It remains anchored by the actual verb of speech and the independently explicit slightness of the merchandise, so it can diagnose a performative echo. Downstream prose should present it as split-root activation, not as a replacement etymology or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Their utterance of need accompanies merchandise openly characterized as slight.

activation_trace.role: Smallness, paucity, and impoverishment make the act of saying itself echo the low status the speakers perform.
The explicitly slight and poorly regarded tender gives the split-root echo a visible material counterpart.
The addressee's strength and honor sharpen the contrast with the petitioners' enacted littleness.

changed_reading.before: Their speech only reports their low resources.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the speech performs littleness as well as naming it: diminished speakers place diminished goods before concentrated power.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant mapped cutting root behind the recompense occurrence. It remains anchored by the packet-resolved split mapping and by the focus's sequence of a severed portion, requested completion, and recompense. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material counter-image, not claim that the recompense verb literally means cutting here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A cut-off portion of wealth and a deficient tender are answered by full measure and divine recompense.

activation_trace.role: Shearing or cutting supplies a latent material opposite to the restorative sufficiency promised by recompense.
The moment something is ripe for cutting adds a harvest edge to a scene governed by food scarcity and measured provision.
A piece severed from a whole makes the offered property materially fragmentary before its commercial sense is applied.
Completion without shortage opposes the fragmenting image and gives the outlier its restorative direction.

changed_reading.before: Divine recompense is an abstract promise of reward for generosity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recompense carries a cutting-season counter-image: what arrives as a severed, exhausted portion is answered by an economy that completes rather than further diminishes.

strongest_changes: The failed person-for-person substitution makes charity the noncoercive bridge for an unequal exchange.
The poverty plea becomes unwitting testimony before the concealed brother who can hear more in it than the speakers know.
Household distress widens from famine to a dispersed kinship wound, while full measure scales toward full reunion.
Commercial measure and recompense become a moral account completed through free favor, withheld blame, forgiveness, and mercy.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses several live mechanisms into one petition: inadequate tender, complete measure, voluntary surplus, divine return, concealed identity, and damaged kinship. Context does not resolve these into one reading; it lets the same transaction function as legal correction, testimony, hope-bearing motion, misvaluation, moral remission, and a small rehearsal of reunion. The two packet-resolved split roots preserve stranger echoes of littleness and cutting without promoting them to ordinary lexical meanings.
remaining_uncertainties: How far "our household" intentionally reaches beyond famine-struck dependents to Jacob, Joseph, and the whole dispersed family remains uncertain.
The extension from measured grain to waived moral debt is structurally strong but still a reader-supplied cross-domain arrow.
The contrast between low merchandise and failure to recognize a high-value brother may be designed resonance or contextual coincidence.
The smallness and cutting outliers depend on non-dominant mapped roots and should remain explicitly exploratory.
